title: Four languages associated with a machine
statement: For a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean alphabet, define a family of four languages indexed by $j\in\{0,1,2,3\}$: the language at index $0$ is the input-length language, and those at indices $1$, $2$, and $3$ are respectively the initialization, acceptance, and step languages associated with $N$.
hypotheses_covered: N is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean alphabet
